description.value: Kourosh Foods Market is a Persian-focused supermarket in North Vancouver stocking fresh produce, meats, dairy, and a wide range of Middle Eastern and Iranian specialty products including traditional flat breads, Persian cookies, rose water, and pomegranate paste. The store also operates an online shop with delivery. Touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver would find it a useful resupply point for fresh fruit, snacks, and pantry staples.
